subject: missouri-house-map
story_title: Missouri's highest court says the new U.S. House map never became law and sends it to a November vote

sub_events.label: Missouri Supreme Court opinion in von Glahn v. Hoskins
Stay application to the U.S. Supreme Court

records.title: Missouri Supreme Court summary of von Glahn v. Hoskins
records.quote: HB 1 is not the law and never has been the law.
records.about: The court’s own communications summary of the September 3 ruling. The summary says it is not part of the opinion and that quotes should go to the opinion.

records.title: Opinion in von Glahn v. Hoskins, SC101805
records.quote: HB 1 is not the law and has never been the law.
records.about: The September 3 opinion, recovered from the appendix the attorney general filed with the U.S. Supreme Court because Missouri’s court site does not let its pages be saved from this machine. The court-origin file is https://www.courts.mo.gov/file/SC/Opinion_SC101805.pdf.

records.title: Mandate and order denying stay, SC101805
records.quote: overruled
records.about: The September 3 mandate reversing Cole County, and the September 4 order denying a stay pending appeal to the U.S. Supreme Court.

records.title: Emergency application for stay, Hoskins v. Von Glahn
records.publisher: Office of the Missouri Attorney General
records.quote: A federal-election-administration disaster is unfolding in Missouri
records.about: The attorney general’s September 4 stay application to the U.S. Supreme Court, including the overseas-ballot date, the requested September 14 decision, and the Elections Clause and Purcell arguments.

records.title: U.S. Supreme Court docket 26A304
records.publisher: Supreme Court of the United States
records.quote: Response to application (26A304) requested by Justice Kavanaugh, due by Noon (EDT) on September 7, 2026.
records.about: The public docket for the stay application, including Kavanaugh’s response deadline.

records.title: Von Glahn opposition to the stay application
records.quote: HB 1 is not the law and has never been the law.
records.about: The challenger’s opposition, arguing the U.S. Supreme Court lacks jurisdiction over a state-law holding.

records.title: Attorney General Hanaway statement on the Missouri Supreme Court decision
records.publisher: Office of the Missouri Attorney General
records.quote: Never before in American history has a court overturned a congressional map after a primary and before a general election.
records.about: Hanaway’s written statement the day of the ruling, saying the office would go to the U.S. Supreme Court.

records.title: Constitution of Missouri, article III, referendum clauses
records.quote: reject by referendum any act of the general assembly, except as hereinafter provided.
records.about: The constitutional text the court applied: referendum on any act of the general assembly, and when a referred measure takes effect.

records.title: Missouri court blocks Trump-backed US House map and orders it to be put to a vote
records.quote: six Republicans and two Democrats
records.about: Associated Press dispatch carried by ABC: the ruling, the current House split, and the Kansas City district.

records.title: Missouri takes redistricting battle to US Supreme Court
records.quote: Missouri appealed to the U.S. Supreme Court on Friday
records.about: AP on the Friday stay application, Kavanaugh’s Monday deadline, and the state’s claim it is unsure it can switch maps.

records.title: Missouri AG appeals to Supreme Court after suffering redistricting loss
records.quote: catastrophic ruling
records.about: Fox News on Hanaway’s emergency appeal and her quoted statement.

records.title: Missouri Supreme Court pauses GOP gerrymander, likely netting Democrats 1 House seat
records.about: Politico’s Thursday account, including a 7-0 count that matches seven judges and “All concur.”

records.title: Missouri Supreme Court throws out GOP-favored House maps
records.quote: did not go into effect and will not go into effect unless and until approved by the voters
records.about: The Hill’s Thursday report quoting the court’s holding on House Bill 1.

records.title: Trump condemns Missouri redistricting ruling
records.quote: did not go into effect and will not go into effect
records.about: The Hill on Trump’s reaction and the court’s holding that the map did not go into effect.

records.title: Missouri asks US Supreme Court to restore Republican-friendly congressional map
records.quote: 6-1 GOP-favored design
records.about: The Hill’s Friday piece on the stay application. It mislabels the prior map as 6-1.

records.title: Missouri high court blocks redrawn GOP map, earns Trump’s ire
records.quote: horrible, ridiculous, and unConstitutional
records.about: USA Today on the ruling and Trump’s social-media post as the outlet recorded it.

records.title: Missouri asks Supreme Court to back GOP-drawn congressional map
records.quote: A federal-election-administration disaster is unfolding in Missouri
records.about: USA Today on the Friday stay application and the September 8 ballot deadline.

records.title: Hoskins reply in support of the stay application
records.publisher: Office of the Missouri Attorney General
records.quote: the State will use the HB 1 map for the 2026 General
records.about: The September 8 reply: if the U.S. Supreme Court stays the injunction, Missouri will use House Bill 1 for the general election.

records.title: Missouri Secretary of State petitions page
records.quote: Initiative & Referendum Petitions
records.about: The secretary’s petitions page saved September 8. It does not list petition 2026-R004.

records.title: What to know about latest Missouri redistricting ruling
records.quote: political parties can decide on their own nominees
records.about: The Hill’s later rundown, citing St. Louis Public Radio on the two options discussed for nominees.

records.title: Stay application appendix, volume 1
records.publisher: Office of the Missouri Attorney General
records.quote: Judgment of the Circuit Court of Cole County, Missouri
records.about: Volume 1 of the appendix filed with the stay application. The table of contents dates the Cole County judgment August 19, 2026. The judgment pages themselves have no readable text layer.

records.title: Stay application appendix, volume 2
records.publisher: Office of the Missouri Attorney General
records.quote: Certificate of Insufficiency
records.about: Volume 2 of the appendix. The certificate of insufficiency at 597a has no readable text layer. The opinion’s quotation of the certificate is the record.

records.title: Maggard v. State, SC101581
records.quote: did not take effect on December 11
records.about: May 2026 opinion. Public copy hosted by Justia because Missouri’s court site does not let its pages be saved from this machine.

records.title: House Bill 1, truly agreed to and finally passed
records.quote: TRULY AGREED TO AND FINALLY PASSED
records.about: The enrolled text of House Bill 1. New districts are effective beginning with the election of the 120th Congress.

records.title: Missouri House Journal, September 12, 2025
records.quote: HB 1 was read the third time and passed
records.about: The House third-reading roll call on House Bill 1: 90 ayes, 65 noes.

records.title: Missouri Senate Journal, September 12, 2025
records.quote: HB 1 was read the 3rd time and finally passed
records.about: The Senate third-reading roll call on House Bill 1: 21 yeas, 11 nays.

records.title: 52 U.S.C. 20302, state responsibilities for overseas ballots
records.publisher: United States House of Representatives, Office of the Law Revision Counsel
records.quote: not later than 45 days before the election
records.about: The federal overseas-ballot statute. It requires ballots 45 days before the election. It does not name September 19.

records.title: Governor Kehoe signs Missouri First Map into law
records.publisher: Office of the Governor of Missouri
records.quote: Today, Governor Mike Kehoe signed House Bill (HB) 1
records.about: The governor’s September 28, 2025, signing release for House Bill 1.

records.title: Statement from Secretary of State Denny Hoskins
records.quote: We may have lost the battle today, but the war to preserve our constitutional republic is far from over
records.about: Hoskins’s written statement the day of the ruling.

records.title: Harris v. Hoskins, SC101806
records.quote: before September 8, 2026
records.about: Companion ruling the same day on an initiative petition. Public copy hosted by Justia.

records.title: People Not Politicians v. Hoskins, SC101801
records.quote: dismissing the case as moot
records.about: Companion ruling the same day, dismissing a related case as moot. Public copy hosted by Justia.

records.title: Changing the Maps: Tracking Mid-Decade Redistricting
records.quote: Since summer 2025, 10 states have changed their congressional maps
records.about: NCSL’s tracker of mid-decade congressional map changes.

records.publisher: Supreme Court of the United States
records.quote: improperly inserted itself into an active
records.about: The U.S. Supreme Court stay of a Texas redistricting order, cited by Missouri in its application.

records.title: Missouri Revised Statutes section 115.367
records.quote: the boundaries of a district have been altered
records.about: Nominating-committee makeup when district boundaries change.

records.title: Missouri Revised Statutes section 115.363
records.quote: is disqualified
records.about: Replacing a nominee who dies, withdraws, or is disqualified.

records.title: Missouri Revised Statutes section 115.125
records.quote: eighth Tuesday before the election
records.about: Late ballot changes no later than 5:00 p.m. on the eighth Tuesday before the election.

records.title: U.S. House party breakdown
records.quote: 218 Republicans
records.about: The House’s own count: 218 Republicans, 214 Democrats, 1 Independent, 2 vacancies, last updated September 2.

records.quote: duly and lawfully
